tiers.effect: Every on-board 【哥伦比亚】 operator counts as carrying one extra piece of equipment (+1 per 50 layers); at battle start each 【哥伦比亚】 operator gains ATK = (equipped items + that extra) × (20% + 0.1%·L). On first activation the player gains 1 源石辅助仪.
On first activation the player gains 1 more 源石辅助仪; at the start of every prep (进入休整期时) the player gains 1 random golden item of random tier.

spec.layerGain: Economy-driven like every other core bond.
spec.howToPlay: Field 【哥伦比亚】 operators (红豆 / 锡人 / 雷蛇 / 赫默 / 白面鸮 / 塞雷娅 …) and stack 源石辅助仪 on them: the item eats the other equipment each prep and grows with the bond's layers.
assumed: 「视为额外携带了1件装备」 is a virtual +1 to the carried-equipment COUNT used by this bond's ATK term (real per-carrier capacity comes from 源石辅助仪's 装备格+2/+4), not a real third slot
「3人数 <首次激活时>」 and 「6人数 <首次激活时>」 each grant once per match (two grants in total)
a full carrier can still take 源石辅助仪 (its own 装备格 bonus raises the cap)
